docs.summary: A recorded ray segment from a bake-time path trace. The demo uses these to draw the bounce chain for a hovered texel each frame so you can see exactly where the path tracer's rays are going (and which ones get occluded).
World-space ray endpoint: either the hit position or origin + dir * maxT if no hit.
0 = primary bounce direction from the texel, 1 = first bounce, etc.
True for shadow rays (NEE direct lighting); false for diffuse bounce rays.
True if this ray hit something within its [`End`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.DebugSegment~End); false if it missed (only meaningful for shadow rays and bounce rays that go off into the sky).
